afterDefects: Flat, slightly dusty beige surroundings. Low saturation outside the court. The far-side net reflection looks a bit odd.
The image is muted and slightly washed out, with low contrast from a pinkish-beige haze. The court blue is desaturated. There is no clear beach character apart from the sand colour.
Slightly muted, dusty palette and low contrast on the sand surround. The court reads a bit flat. Otherwise there is a dense crowd and the players are readable.
Heavily saturated orange that is close to monochrome. The upper background is a blurry, dark skybox. The players are small in the frame. Otherwise strong warm lighting, a full crowd and good depth.
The frame is mostly orange with heavy shadows. The blurry background structure and dark sky are a bit muddy. The players are small but readable.

Faint ghost reflections of the signage on the court surface. The backdrop sky is blurry and low-res, and the camera is far enough back that the players look small. Otherwise the warm lighting is strong and the depth and crowd are good.
Slightly dark vignetted corners. Bright floodlight hotspots on the stands at the edges. Minor reflection artefacts under the players.
The surround is somewhat dark and teal, with soft light blotches at the edges. The player shadows are faint. Otherwise the crowd, signage and court texture are good.
Uneven lighting with dark corners and bright floor hotspots by the stands. The surround is a little murky. The crowd is dense and the court and players are clear.
Dim, muddy default scene. Sparse cylinder crowd. Blank scoreboards. Black blob shadows. No desert theme.
The palette is pale and low contrast. The court teal and the sand both look slightly washed out. The background structure is blurry.

Somewhat washed out and low contrast: the beige ground, pale teal court and pale sky blend together. Small players and faint signage reflections on the court. Still readable, with a good crowd and stadium depth.
The surroundings are fairly uniform dark green. The background skybox is blurry. The players are small.
The surround green is a bit dark and murky. The background treeline is blurry. Otherwise it is readable, with good crowd detail.
Blurry backdrop, faint ghost reflections of the signage on the court, and small players at this camera distance. Otherwise the striped grass, crowd and shadows look good.
Very dark surroundings with crushed blacks at the edges. The ghosted scoreboard reflection on the court is distracting. Still high contrast and readable, and the theme comes through clearly.
Large black areas surround the court. The background is very dark, though that suits the moon theme. The scoreboard text reflection on the court is slightly distracting.

Very dark surround that crushes the crowd's shadow side. Ghost reflections of the signage on the court, and a crowd on the moon is thematically odd. The court and the white astronaut players read clearly, and the moon backdrop adds atmosphere.
